critical_code_review_comments: master_brain_tools.py is ~1600 lines — consider splitting per-tool modules (each `_tool_*` + shared helpers) since it now hosts read+action+campaign tools; hurts readability & test isolation.

credit_points_from_file returns audit_id inside result_preview only as a string (500-char truncation in _run_tool_loop) — long tool results may be lost from the trace. Consider persisting full tool results (or ensuring key fields like audit_id are always in the reply) for auditability of long chats.

mb_credit_jobs_col and CREDIT_JOB_DB_DEADLINE constant remain even though the background worker is removed — dead-code / minor confusion (the collection is still updated inside _credit_pairs / _reverse_changes_bulk via `if job_id`, which is never truthy from callers now). Safe to remove.
scheduler.py: mb_credit_worker was removed; grep confirms no residual references, good.
